goal: Phase 5 Frontier Deep Learning Theory Sprint: (A) Multi-Layer Transformer End-to-End Generalization, In-Context Learning Sample Complexity, and Mechanistic Circuit / Safety Intervention Bounds (TransformerGeneralization.lean); (B) Convolutional & Vision Architecture Translation Equivariance, Receptive-Field Stability, and Architecture-Comparative Generalization (CNN vs. MLP vs. Transformer) (ConvolutionalGeneralization.lean); (C) Momentum, EMA, and AdamW Trajectory Stability, Effective Curvature Damping, and Optimizer Generalization Comparison (MomentumAdamTrajectory.lean); (D) Spiked-Covariance Representation Learning & Sample Complexity Separation Between μP and Frozen-Kernel NTK (SpikedSampleComplexity.lean).
summary: 4-track parallel formalization of Transformer generalization & safety control, CNN/Vision equivariance & locality advantage, Momentum/AdamW EMA dynamics, and Spiked-Covariance μP vs. NTK sample complexity separation with 0 sorry and 0 warnings

tasks.name: worker-transformer-generalization-and-safety
tasks.scopedGoal: Create OpenTheory/Generalization/TransformerGeneralization.lean and tests/TransformerGeneralizationSmoke.lean. Formalize (1) Multi-layer Transformer forward stability and parameter-to-output Lipschitz propagation across L attention+FFN residual blocks; (2) Covering number and high-probability uniform generalization / approximate-ERM excess risk tail bounds for L-layer Transformers; (3) End-to-end In-Context Learning (ICL) excess risk decomposition combining T-step query-key margin growth (InContextRetrieval) with out-of-sample generalization; and (4) Mechanistic interpretability & safety intervention guarantees (bounding target task risk degradation vs. unsafe subspace suppression under circuit/head ablation and activation steering across L layers).
acceptance: OpenTheory/Generalization/TransformerGeneralization.lean compiles with zero sorry and zero warnings

tasks.name: worker-cnn-vision-equivariance-generalization
tasks.scopedGoal: Create OpenTheory/Architectures/ConvolutionalGeneralization.lean and tests/ConvolutionalGeneralizationSmoke.lean. Formalize (1) 1D/spatial patch-based convolutional layer semantics with kernel size k <= d, weight sharing across n_p spatial positions, and activation σ; (2) Exact shift/translation equivariance of convolutional feature maps and global average pooling translation invariance; (3) Receptive-field operator norm and parameter-perturbation Lipschitz bounds; and (4) Architecture-comparative covering number and sample complexity separation proving that for k-local shift-equivariant tasks, weight-shared CNNs require O(c * k) effective parameters whereas dense MLPs require O(m * d) parameters, yielding a strict generalization bound and sample complexity advantage whenever k < d.
acceptance: OpenTheory/Architectures/ConvolutionalGeneralization.lean compiles with zero sorry and zero warnings

tasks.name: worker-momentum-adamw-ema-trajectory
tasks.scopedGoal: Create OpenTheory/Optimization/MomentumAdamTrajectory.lean and tests/MomentumAdamTrajectorySmoke.lean. Formalize (1) Exponential Moving Average (EMA) first-moment momentum state recurrence m_{t+1} = β m_t + (1 - β) g_t, bias-corrected moment hat_m_t, and closed-form geometric weight sum identity; (2) Variance reduction of EMA momentum gradients under mini-batch noise σ^2/B by the exact factor (1 - β)/(1 + β), proving strict reduction of the stochastic PL noise floor for Momentum/Adam over memoryless SGD when 0 < β < 1; (3) Decoupled weight decay (AdamW) explicit parameter norm envelope ‖u_T‖ <= R_AdamW = step_bound / λ_w and induced trajectory-ball generalization guarantee; and (4) Exact optimizer selection theorem comparing Scalar SGD vs. Momentum SGD vs. Diagonal Preconditioned / AdamW across anisotropic curvature and gradient noise regimes.
acceptance: OpenTheory/Optimization/MomentumAdamTrajectory.lean compiles with zero sorry and zero warnings

tasks.name: worker-spiked-covariance-mup-ntk-separation
tasks.scopedGoal: Create OpenTheory/Generalization/SpikedSampleComplexity.lean and tests/SpikedSampleComplexitySmoke.lean. Formalize (1) Spiked-covariance data model (connecting Data/Model.lean and Data/Spectrum.lean) where target y* lives on an r-dimensional leading signal subspace (r << d) with spike eigenvalue λ_1 = leading and bulk eigenvalue λ_perp = bulk; (2) Frozen-kernel NTK vs. μP feature-aligned effective dimension and ridge risk decomposition; (3) Strict statistical risk and sample complexity separation proving that after t >= alignmentHorizon of μP feature learning, the off-subspace bulk variance and bias are suppressed by exp(-2 * lr * gap * t), reducing effective complexity from ambient dimension d to spike rank r; and (4) Joint activation-data-parameterization comparison theorem.
acceptance: OpenTheory/Generalization/SpikedSampleComplexity.lean compiles with zero sorry and zero warnings
